policy: Identical fixed 16 ms output delay for static and tracked causal FIR residuals. Every 256 samples compare normalized correlation of the last 128 ms to the predicted echo at all +/-256 sample offsets. A new lag needs reference RMS >=64, correlation >=.55 and improvement >=.10. Faults start when the address would begin, including both reference-only controls. Independent raw C161 remains on its own input clock. Charge the archived serial verifier P95 times. Full two-second host residual PCM ASR, no Opus, filter/tracker execution or physical hardware timing.
